stumbles.quote: names the Muninn `github` tool call to use instead
stumbles.why: Muninn is never explained, so a first-time reader can't tell what it is or where the `github` tool comes from.
The text doesn't say why the calls return 403, for example a permissions or token limit in sessions. A reader can't tell whether the guard is a workaround or a policy.
"Session" is never defined. The reader has to guess what kind of session this means, probably an agent session.

point: The commit extends a guard script so that `gh api` POSTs to `/releases` or `/git/refs` are blocked, like `gh release create`, because those calls return 403, and the guard points to the Muninn `github` tool instead.
